audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side reads "Sylas" while every content win[N] reads Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei and every phases[N].why describes Hwei winning that stage. The page renders two different answers to who wins each level.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Hwei, Hwei, Hwei, Skill, Skill, Hwei, Hwei] and matches the content layer exactly; the full layer is the outlier. Win rate 52.16% over 4444 games supports Hwei-favoured early rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and late attribute Sylas's sustain to Petricite Burst.
audit.why: Petricite Burst is a charge-based on-attack magic damage and attack speed passive with no healing. The heal is Kingslayer (W), 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, which heals against enemy champions. Hijack is 80/55/30s.
audit.corrected: Sustain re-attributed to Kingslayer (W); anti-heal timing named; Hijack cooldown numbers stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls the chain-strike ability "Kingslayer (Q)"; mid and whys[3] claim Sylas gets "Q resets from minion waves"; wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0] call Q a dash.
audit.why: Chain Lash is Q (775 range, 10/9/8/7/6s, slow); Kingslayer is W (400 range, dash + heal); Abscond/Abduct is E (400 range, 13/12/11/10/9s), the dash-then-chain-pull. Sylas has no Q reset mechanic anywhere in his kit.
audit.corrected: Real slot names and ranges used; the reset claim removed and replaced with the true rank-5 cooldown compression on Q and W.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E text, ranges and per-rank cooldowns

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E fear paint like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5 — the dash-then-chain that starts every Sylas kill. While it is down he cannot reach you. - Kingslayer heals off you every 12s early. - Hijack is 80s at rank 1.

edits.before: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: A wave he can Abduct you over is a wave too far up; ward both bushes so the 13s dash never starts unseen.

edits.before: QQ his last-hit, weave any second spell for the mark, detonate, and reset to max range — two-spell trades he answers only by overextending.
edits.after: Abduct is his only way in and the fear paint answers it. Spend E on poke and his 13-second dash arrives with nothing to stop it.

edits.before: Sylas burns Abscond / Abduct on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Sylas spends Abscond on nothing — that is a 13-second window, take it.

edits.before: That is Sylas’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: You have no dash; Abscond into Abduct is two moves at you — never walk home unpainted.

edits.before: Standing mid-cast-animation inside his engage range with the fear already spent — every assassin and fighter in the pool is waiting for exactly that frame.
edits.after: A third paint locks you in animation inside 400-range Abduct with E spent — that is the exact frame Sylas dashes, chains, and Kingslayers off you.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Sylas wins by Absconding onto you mid-paint, chaining you still, and healing the trade back with Kingslayer before your mark detonates.

edits.before: Carry through range — no mid pool champion paints a teamfight from further away; your R + QQ decides objectives before they start.
edits.after: Carry through range: Sylas must cross 400 units of Abduct to touch you, so R their engage at 1300 and let QQ finish what the slow holds.

edits.before: If Sylas gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Abscond / Abduct extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with QA clears and stay relevant through max-range poke.
edits.after: One kill and Kingslayer heals him through your chip — stand a screen back and farm with QA. Two kills and his 13s Abduct reaches you through minions, so buy Zhonya's early and paint only from behind the wave.

edits.before: Ahead, paint the prison: mark-detonate Sylas on every last-hit, shove with QA, and rotate first to every river — your R range means you join fights he can't even see.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the heal: mark-detonate him on every last-hit so Kingslayer never catches up, buy Grievous Wounds early, and shove with QA to roam while his 80s Hijack is down.

edits.before: Sylas has to close the gap through your Q/E poke zone before Kingslayer (Q) chain-strikes land, so you punish every approach and keep him below 60% before he can start a trade.
edits.after: Sylas has to cross your Q and E zones before Chain Lash (Q) lands at 775 range, and his only gap-closer is Abscond into Abduct (E) — punish every step-up and keep him low before he starts a trade.

edits.before: Your burst combo comes online slightly ahead of his all-in threshold, letting you punish any dive attempt before his sustain from Petricite Burst kicks in.
edits.after: Your first-item burst lands ahead of his all-in threshold — detonate the mark before Kingslayer (W) heals him back, since that heal is his only sustain in the trade.

edits.before: Once your first item comes online your burst combo punishes his all-in attempts before his healing from Petricite Burst can offset the damage. Track his ultimate charge and whatever he's stolen recently — a well-timed Hijack can flip a fight, so keep E ready to interrupt his dive and don't commit without vision on his position.
edits.after: Once your first item comes online your burst punishes his all-in attempts before Kingslayer (W) heals the damage back, so Grievous Wounds keeps the maths yours. Track Hijack — 80s at rank 1, 30s at rank 3 — and whatever he last stole, keep E ready to interrupt his dive, and don't commit without vision on his position.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 you keep winning the poke war, but respect that his all-in burst gets scarier once he has more Q resets from minion waves. Level 6 Hijack is the real inflection point — he can steal a nearby ultimate (including yours or an ally's engage), so be aware of what's on cooldown before grouping for objectives. If he doesn't get a clean stolen-ult engage, you're still ahead on trades and can keep poking him down safely.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 you keep winning the poke war, but respect that Chain Lash (Q) falls to 6 seconds and Kingslayer (W) to 6 by rank 5, so his sustained trade gets real. If he doesn't get a clean stolen-ult engage, you're still ahead on trades and can keep poking him down safely.

edits.before: Sylas has to walk through real damage to reach you — your Q fire form and E poke chip him hard before he ever gets a Kingslayer chain off, and his short dash range means levels 1-2 favor you clearly. He's built to snowball off successful all-ins, so denying him easy trades early keeps him weak the whole game. Stay at range, poke on cooldown, and punish overextensions.
